item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The graph shows rainfall in millimetres for stations P and Q across four months that Imran recorded in order. He is choosing between this line graph and a display with many clustered bars.

Which claim about this display is correct?

options.A: The display is a chart of clustered bars for the four months.
options.B: Month order can be ignored because the points are already plotted.
options.C: The line graph compares the two stations across the ordered months more clearly than many clustered bars.
options.D: Only the highest rainfall point on the graph matters for the comparison.
